an4.115:2.1: Tatra bhikkhave yam idaṃ ṭhānaṃ amanāpaṃ kātuṃ
an4.115:2.3: idaṃ bhikkhave ṭhānaṃ ubhayen' eva na kattabbaṃ maññati,
an4.115:2.4: yam p' idaṃ ṭhānaṃ amanāpaṃ kātuṃ
an4.115:2.5: iminā pi taṃ na kattabbaṃ maññati,
an4.115:2.6: yam p' idaṃ ṭhānaṃ kayiramānaṃ anaṭṭhāya saṃvattati
an4.115:2.7: iminā pi taṃ na kattabbaṃ maññati,
an4.115:2.8: idaṃ bhikkhave ṭhānaṃ ubhayena na kattabbaṃ maññati. 3.
an4.115:3.1: Tatra bhikkhave yam idaṃ ṭhānaṃ amanāpaṃ kātuṃ
an4.115:3.3: imasmiṃ bhikkhave ṭhāne bālo ca paṇḍito ca veditabbo purisatthāme purisaviriye purisaparakkame,
an4.115:3.6: atha carah' idam ṭhānaṃ kayiramānaṃ atthāya saṃvattatīti,
an4.115:3.8: tassa taṃ ṭhānaṃ akayiramanam anatthāya saṃvattati.
an4.115:3.9: Paṇḍito ca kho bhikkhave iti paṭisañcikkhati--kiñcāpi
an4.115:3.11: atha carah' idaṃ ṭhānaṃ kayiramānaṃ atthāya saṃvattatīti,
an4.115:3.13: tassa taṃ ṭhānaṃ kayiramānaṃ atthāya saṃvattati. 4.
an4.115:4.1: Tatra bhikkhave yam idaṃ ṭhānaṃ manāpaṃ kātuṃ
an4.115:4.3: imasmim pi bhikkhave ṭhāne bālo ca paṇḍito ca veditabbo purisatthāme purisaviriye purisaparakkame,
an4.115:4.6: atha carah' idaṃ ṭhānaṃ kayiramānaṃ anatthāya saṃvattatīti,
an4.115:4.8: tassa taṃ ṭhānaṃ kayiramānaṃ anatthāya saṃvattati.
an4.115:4.9: Paṇḍito ca kho bhikkhave iti paṭisañcikkhati--kiñcāpi
an4.115:4.11: atha carah' idaṃ ṭhānaṃ kayiramānaṃ anatthāya saṃvattatīti,
an4.115:4.13: tassa taṃ ṭhānaṃ akayiramānaṃ atthāya saṃvattati. 5.
an4.115:5.1: Tatra bhikkhave yam idaṃ ṭhānaṃ manāpaṃ kātuṃ tañ ca kayiramānaṃ atthāya saṃvattati
an4.115:5.2: idaṃ bhikkhave ṭhānaṃ ubhayen' eva kattabbaṃ maññati
an4.115:5.3: yam p' idaṃ ṭhānaṃ manāpaṃ kātuṃ iminā pi taṃ kattabbaṃ maññati
an4.115:5.4: yam p' idaṃ ṭhānaṃ kayiramānaṃ atthāya saṃvattati iminā pi taṃ kattabbaṃ maññati,
an4.115:5.5: idam bhikkhave thānam ubhayen' eva kattabbaṃ maññati.
